name: Names this project's own visual-regression command

item_template.title: Decide the visual regression check for this repo
item_template.description: Read the repository you are given and decide whether visual regression can be checked here, and with what command.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the repository, when it declares visual regression tooling, then the command that runs it is named.

judge_criteria: The summary says where in the repository it found the answer — a script, a config file or a CI job.
The summary does not mention a threshold, budget or baseline that the repository does not already declare.

notes: The job: find the project's own snapshot tooling and its committed baselines. The second criterion is the whole point of ADR 0024 — a checker that invents a number has reintroduced the guessing the scripts were deleted for.

name: Says so plainly when the project has no such tooling

item_template.title: Decide the visual regression check for this repo
item_template.description: Read the repository you are given. If it has no visual regression tooling of its own, say so rather than proposing one.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given a repository with no visual regression tooling, when the checker answers, then it reports that the check does not apply and why.

notes: A project that ships no visual tooling gets no visual check. Atlas records that as skipped, which is an honest "nobody checked" — better than a green from tooling Atlas introduced behind the Owner's back.

name: Reads the repo and changes nothing

item_template.title: Decide the visual regression check for this repo
item_template.description: Read the repository you are given and answer. Do not configure anything.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the repository, when the checker has answered, then the working tree is unchanged.

notes: A checker runs on every delivery, before anything has been reviewed. One that scaffolds tooling would be committing config nobody asked for, on a branch about to become a pull request.
